integrity: The pre-first-rejection recursion was reconstructed directly from the primary SAFFRON paper, the stage reduction was proved algebraically, and finite exact-rational checks were replayed. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact law assumes the original constant-lambda SAFFRON rule, independent exactly uniform p-values, and a complete null.
The simplified gamma-product envelope requires the threshold cap to be inactive; the general first product includes capping.
The theorem concerns the first rejection/eventual complete-null FDR, not the full rejection-count process after wealth rewards activate.
An older equivalent derivation under alpha-investing, renewal, or online-FWER terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact complete-null first-rejection law for SAFFRON
